validation_notes: From mid-July onward price has mostly moved sideways in a choppy range between ~90 and ~103 without clear convergence. Highs are not forming a consistent descending line (e.g., Jul 20-22 peaks near 102-103 are similar to early-Aug peaks near 98-99, and lows bounce around 90-96 without a clean flat support). This looks more like a broad horizontal consolidation/range than a descending triangle with a defined flat bottom and lower highs converging toward an apex. There isn't a clean, repeated touch pattern on both sides compressing toward a point near the right edge - the recent candles (late Jul-early Aug) show a slight uptrend in both highs and lows, which contradicts a descending triangle structure. I'd call this a non-triangle consolidation rather than a credible descending triangle.
